title: Core Septet #17
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 16:9 aspect ratio, significantly wider than it is tall, seven women in a single row.

A photograph of SEVEN women standing side by side in a single row at the same ground level on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, each woman in her own distinct pose, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, all real photographic skin with visible pores, no illustration finish, no CG sheen, all faces, hands and feet in correct proportion. The camera set back so all 7 fit comfortably within the wide frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left to right:
[Gangnam-eonni / Black Glamour]: Korean woman, early 50s, cool and composed, glowing dewy skin, a precise winged liner, softly defined brown eyeshadow, full natural lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, sculpted contour with a satin highlight, plump glossy rose-coral lips, a poised, refined, confident expression, soft pastel-pink hair styled in a natural afro in a full rounded silhouette, coffin nails (holographic). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Japanese Kutani porcelain (a cream-white ground with bold red, gold and green overglaze enamels), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip. Shoes: extreme gold-and-red ballet heels.

[Egyptian Glam / Hourglass SSBBW]: Egyptian woman, late 40s, sultry, warm golden-bronze skin, sharp winged kohl liner, a deep terracotta-red lip, warm chestnut-brown hair styled in long thick box braids, square nails (matte). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, projecting forward past the line of her own knees, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Croatian Hvar filigree-inspired linework (an ivory ground with fine cream and gold painted filigree linework), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: both hands framing her own face. Shoes: extreme gold platform stiletto heels.

[Bollywood Glam / Glamour Hourglass]: Indian woman, mid 20s, cool and composed, kohl-lined almond eyes, a small gold bindi, a deep maroon-red lip, warm golden-brown skin, cool ash-brown hair styled in sleek straight, stiletto nails (holographic). Not thin, not androgynous, not boyish, not a straight figure. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Pose: leaning one arm on a window frame. Shoes: extreme gold-and-red platform stiletto studded boots.

[Instagram glam / Black Glamour]: American woman, mid 20s, bold and confident, sun-kissed skin, heavily sculpted contour and a strong highlighter on the cheekbones, bold defined brows, long fluffy false lashes, shimmery bronze eyeshadow, large eyes with bright real catchlights, plump glossy nude lips with a defined lip-liner outline, a confident, camera-ready smile, bold vivid violet-purple hair styled in many small bantu knots covering the scalp, coffin nails (holographic). [telenovela glam / Curved Bust]: Latina woman, late 50s, cheerful, warm golden-bronze skin, a sharp black winged liner, warm terracotta eyeshadow, heavy lashes, strong sculpted contour, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep berry lip, a fiery, passionate expression, a distinct two-tone ombre with dark roots and a sharp transition to light ends hair styled in high ponytail, round nails (glittery). Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, every woman an extraordinarily large woman far beyond any real person, generous horizontal spacing so every figure reads clearly and large.

Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 7, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 16:9 landscape 8K.
